absences: Messages: no topic published or consumed in the image files (no AMQP/Kafka client call in image sources or registryclient); RabbitMQ is used only as the Kieker telemetry transport.

Failure timeout and cleanup interval of the registry: library default, not in these files (the registry's expiry logic is in registry files, not given here); image side only shows HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS=2500 (RegistryClient.java:65).
Health check: none in the compose block (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:84-95) or in the image/dockerbase Dockerfiles.
Replica count: no deploy.replicas or scale key; Compose default 1 (documented default).

Jaeger tracer: Tracing.java:42 builds JaegerTracer.Builder(service) with ConstSampler(true) and B3 codecs but sets no reporter, agent host/port or flush interval; no JAEGER_* variable appears in compose or Dockerfiles. Span reporting destination and frequency: library default, not in these files.

Kieker batching: kieker.monitoring.properties:34 deferredWriteDelay=500 and :36 taskRunInterval=20, units not stated in these files; compose sets AMQP heartbeat request 900 s (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:19, :92), image default is 0 (properties:31).
Metrics and logs: no metric exporter configured; logging via slf4j (RegistryClient.java:36), destination set by System.setProperty simpleLogger.logFile=System.out (RegistryClient.java:78).

replicas.note: library default, not in these files: the image service block (docker-compose_kieker.yaml:84-95) has no deploy.replicas or scale key, so Compose runs its default of one container.

exportsTelemetryTo.note: Traces (Kieker operation-execution records) go to the RabbitMQ host named by RABBITMQ_HOST; dockerbase start.sh:35 switches the Kieker writer to ChunkingCollector when RABBITMQ_HOST is set, kieker.monitoring.properties:28 gives AMQP queue name 'kieker'.

registersWith.note: registerOnce() issues an HTTP PUT (line 245 .put(Entity.text(""))) to registryRESTURL; the registry URL is rewritten from REGISTRY_HOST by dockerbase start.sh:9 and REGISTRY_HOST is "registry" at docker-compose_kieker.yaml:90.

syncEdges.note: HTTP/REST via Jersey client (HttpWrapper.wrap(client.getService()...).get(), lines 161-162). Same callee at SetupController.java:194 (path 'products') and :227 (path 'categories'). Called after startup via ImageProviderStartup.java:61 runAfterServiceIsAvailable(Service.PERSISTENCE ...).

HTTP/REST PUT heartbeat/registration (registerOnce, line 240-251). The same client also does GET of service locations at line 193-195 (getServersForService) and DELETE at line 265 on shutdown (unregisterOnce).

name.note: Name matches the registry extractor fragment; this fragment only records how the image service is tracked by it.

mechanism.note: RegistryClientHeartbeatDaemon.run() calls registerOnce (RegistryClientHeartbeatDaemon.java:40); scheduled only after the persistence-available callback (ImageProviderStartup.java:61-66).

heartbeatIntervalSeconds.note: 2500 ms converted to seconds; TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS at line 160.

heartbeatThreadIndependentOfWork.note: Dedicated single-thread ScheduledExecutorService (lines 69-70), separate from servlet request threads.
